title: fix(types): integrate declarations and preserve published type dependencies
head: fix/published-declaration-authority-20261009
body:
The canonical package producer rebuilt external dependencies from published authority, dropping vue-router/type-fest despite their source manifest declarations. Public component aliases, named emit payload parameters, the Table core Popper return and TableV2 class attributes also produced declaration errors. This isolated source branch integrates five actual author offers and registers the two existing exact dependency pins in published authority; it preserves install versions, source lock, runtime/security controls and local alias ownership.

Exact source: 2d05f240e5fb04ac0cd602b4ed638ffe00b1859b. Actual local tarball SHA256: 6da2fe1a5573a04768a4f8280899b45dabaa4f93ca72a278d48c50faca17649a. Canonical build/verify and fresh naturally resolved frozen install pass. Paired actual package diagnostics: old 48ac artifact 259, integrated 6b735 artifact 78, final artifact 10. Historical 191 was a real stale locked-graph result, not fresh dependency closure; corrected evidence preserves its inputs/logs. Every unaffected third-party package block remains identical. The final artifact has zero missing vue-router/type-fest errors.

WIP: full strict installed declarations still fail 10 diagnostics from four missing barrels and six global exports; final original producer still has twelve independent tracked TS7056. Source Vitest typecheck also fails one imported Table non-null assertion under the existing strictNullChecks=false setting; original Table owner must adjust that test while preserving strict acceptance. Source web check, 22 exact Table/Markdown runtime cases, eight standalone strict motion checks, authority/dependency drift/projection mutation checks, six dedicated positive/negative artifact controls and nine package refusal controls pass. Fresh UI main 8db0 has no conflict with this source.

Related to the issue827/DAG source integration. Runtime/browser/physical-device notch and published-artifact acceptance remains OPEN; remote CI is unrun. No package publication, default push, merge, CSP/security weakening, private consumer CSS or alias repointing. Root coordinator/reviewer owns PR metadata and any merge.
